name: Vienna obstetric hand hygiene
description: The first maternity clinic in Vienna introduced a hand hygiene policy for clinicians in 1847.

date.basis: Source date for the documented context; BP conversion uses 1950 as reference where applicable.

events.statement: The first maternity clinic in Vienna introduced a hand hygiene policy for clinicians in 1847.

evidence.supports: The historical review gives an 1847 hand hygiene intervention in the first Vienna clinic and the reported 1848 annual figures of 45 deaths among 3556 patients. Historical comparisons are observational.

events.caveats: The reported changes in maternal mortality are historical observational comparisons; the policy date does not establish when everyday handwashing began.
